page.overview:
What is If Darkness Had a Son?

If Darkness Had a Son is the ninth track off of Metallica's eleventh studio album 72 Seasons.

It is also the third single from the album. The song was written and composed by James Hetfield, Lars Ulrich and Kirk Hammett.

Temptation Temptation Temptation Temptation
